note: Only results with slot >= post_from_slot are posted (older slots were uploaded by hand). Late (missed) slots within late_post_hours are posted now (shareNow); never skipped silently.
limit_note: Buffer caps YouTube Shorts per channel per rolling 24h since Nov 19 2026 (Free plan: 2; paid+verified email: 100). Posts over the cap fail, so publish schedules each post at the first time the cap allows (within late_post_hours of its slot, or limit_defer_hours for a post the cap already rejected).
